description: Implementation of UE manager for 5G CU-CP, including UE addition, removal, context setting, and metrics reporting.

classes.name: ue_manager
classes.description: Manages UEs, including creation, deletion, context management, and metrics reporting.

classes.name: cu_cp_ue
classes.description: Represents a User Equipment (UE) in the CU-CP context.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the UE manager or UE task scheduler.

methods.name: add_ue
methods.description: Adds a new UE with specified parameters, creating associated context and lookup entries.

methods.name: remove_ue
methods.description: Removes a UE and cleans up associated lookup entries.

methods.name: set_plmn
methods.description: Sets the PLMN identity for a specified UE.

methods.name: add_blocked_plmns
methods.description: Blocks specified PLMNs from UE connections.

methods.name: find_ues
methods.description: Finds all UEs associated with a specific PLMN.

methods.name: get_ue_index
methods.description: Retrieves UE index based on PCI and RNTI or full/short I-RNTI.

methods.name: set_inactive
methods.description: Sets a UE to inactive state and allocates I-RNTIs.

methods.name: set_active
methods.description: Reactivates a UE and removes I-RNTIs from lookup.

methods.name: get_full_i_rnti
methods.description: Retrieves the full I-RNTI for an inactive UE.

methods.name: find_ue
methods.description: Finds a UE object by its index.

methods.name: find_ue_task_scheduler
methods.description: Finds the task scheduler associated with a UE.

methods.name: set_ue_du_context
methods.description: Sets or updates the DU context for a UE.

methods.name: find_du_ue
methods.description: Finds a UE with DU context.

methods.name: get_nof_du_ues
methods.description: Counts UEs connected to a specific DU.

methods.name: handle_ue_metrics_report_request
methods.description: Generates a report of UEs for metrics, if enabled.
